cards.name: Hard Mechanical 32 pixels
cards.summary: A solid, hard-edged line about 32 px wide with round caps and an even weight along the S, with a faintly wobbly edge from the overlapping round stamps (25% spacing); no taper, texture or softness (name and picture agree). Settings read from the .abr file: 32 px round computed tip (hardness 100%), spacing 25%.
use_for: painting flat solid shapes and masks
avoid: it paints in the current foreground colour (the black in the thumbnail is the renderer's colour, not the preset's)
no pressure taper: size does not vary with pen pressure in this preset
cards.applies_to: a pixel layer or a layer mask (not a type, shape or smart-object layer); it paints in the current foreground colour at the layer's current opacity
cards.how_to_apply: Not in the default Brushes panel list: Brushes panel > panel menu > Import Brushes... and pick <Photoshop 2026 install folder>/Presets/Brushes/Legacy Brushes.abr, then choose 'Hard Mechanical 32 pixels' in its 'Basic Brushes' group. Script route (as PGD's gallery run did it): Action Manager setd on the application's Brsh property with the .abr as 'T   ' (Appe false replaces the whole Brushes list, true appends), then slct a Brsh reference by index (the preset's position in the loaded list, plus an offset PGD detected from sampled-tip IDs).
cards.notes: Settings (size, spacing, dynamics) read from the shipped .abr file with PGD's structural reader (binary, decoded not string-scraped). PGD thumbnail: the preset stroked along an S-path with simulated pressure, black on white (an applied render, not the preset's own preview).

verified.note: Black ink on white, 12.97% inked; shape, edge, texture and taper match the card.

cards.notes: Settings (size, spacing, dynamics) read from the shipped .abr file with PGD's structural reader (binary, decoded not string-scraped). PGD thumbnail: the preset stroked along an S-path with simulated pressure, black on white (an applied render, not the preset's own preview).

verified.note: Black ink on white, 6.88% inked; shape, edge, texture and taper match the card.

cards.name: Flat 28 px
cards.summary: A broad flat chisel-nib ribbon about 28 px across along the S with vertically cut square ends: the band is full on the diagonals and pinches to a thin line on the vertical part of the S, with a faint dashed ticking along its edges (nib set at 90 degrees). Name and picture agree (flat brush, roundness 0%). Settings read from the .abr file: 28 px round computed tip (hardness 100%), spacing 1%, angle 90 degrees, roundness 0%.
use_for: ribbons, banners and bold flat-pen marks
avoid: it paints in the current foreground colour (the black in the thumbnail is the renderer's colour, not the preset's)
line weight depends on stroke direction (it thins to a sliver when moving along the nib edge): use a Hard Mechanical round for an even line
no pressure taper: size does not vary with pen pressure in this preset
cards.applies_to: a pixel layer or a layer mask (not a type, shape or smart-object layer); it paints in the current foreground colour at the layer's current opacity
